fullPassage: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have benefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core competencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI. Ask the right questions, rather than merely find answers. Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular. However, things have changed, and now with the presence of AI, many people question why one would memorize such information. Unlike in the past, this is because you can quickly find answers on the Internet, and if you want, an AI assistant will even find an answer for you. In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer. The fact that the computer won a resounding victory shows that humans cannot keep up with computers in finding factual information. If that person were to compete with current AI, he would probably lose by a larger margin. We don't need to memorize all the answers, and no matter how hard we try, we cannot rival AI in memorizing vast quantities of information. What we need to focus on is obtaining the "right" answers from AI, and the key is to ask the right questions to elicit the answer you want from AI. That is not to say you don't need to study. To ask the right questions, you must understand the context in which you're asking the question, and you also need background knowledge on the topic. When AI provides an answer, you must also be able to tell how accurate the answer is. We are currently in an era where the ability to use information is more important than having all the details memorized. We must be able to do what AI is not good at rather than focusing on what AI does best. Develop critical thinking skills for evaluating information. AI can often find the information we want quickly, but there are problems with this. AI creates a lot of false or biased information. Further, AI cannot understand the intentions of the person who created the information, nor does it have the ability to judge whether the information is right or wrong. Moreover, stories of AI providing fake information are often reported. For example, there was a case of a lawyer who submitted non-existent cases made by AI to a real court. There has also been an example of AI recommending restaurants that didn't exist. Just as much as misleading information, feeding biased information into AI causes incorrect or even harmful output. A world-famous Internet company had AI study ten years of employee records to create a new employee selection algorithm. However, the company decided not to use the algorithm when it favored men over women. The proportion of male employees was very high and thus the AI's machine learning had an underlying bias towards male data. When analyzing the information provided by AI, it is always necessary to assess the quality of information — remember: garbage in, garbage out. Develop interpersonal skills that are particularly challenging for AI to replace. It is AI that is good at collecting and classifying information. Meanwhile, it is humans that are best at dealing with people. The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess. Become a life-long learner, embracing changes. According to a future job report published by a top global investment bank, up to 300 million jobs around the world could be affected by artificial intelligence. The report also noted that technological innovation has historically created employment growth in the long run. In the age of AI, the ability to adapt to new technologies and work environments is crucial. You must embrace change and be open to learning and mastering new skills. It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be left behind. That is why we must become life-long learners. Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market. AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more. Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. More likely a person with AI skills will replace you. In conclusion, surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset. Instead of fearing AI, we must embrace it as a companion in this new era and find ways to collaborate with it and complement it. We must also focus on developing interpersonal skills that machines cannot replace. By doing so, we can not only survive in this era of AI but also thrive and prosper.

det.korean: ① AI 시대에 살아남고 번영하기 위해 길러야 할 역량들
det.analysis:
✅ ① what skills people must cultivate to survive and thrive in the AI era(AI 시대에 살아남고 번영하기 위해 길러야 할 역량): 올바른 질문·비판적 사고·대인관계·평생 학습을 다루는 글 전체를 아우름 ← 정답

❌ ② how supercomputers came to defeat human quiz champions(슈퍼컴퓨터가 퀴즈 챔피언을 이긴 과정): 하나의 예시일 뿐 주제가 아님

❌ ③ the technical process behind AI disease diagnosis programs(AI 질병 진단 프로그램의 기술적 과정): 대인관계 역량의 예시일 뿐임

❌ ④ the exact number of jobs a global bank predicted(은행이 예측한 정확한 일자리 수): 세부 사실일 뿐 주제가 아님
det.tip: 네 가지 핵심 역량을 관통하는 것 = AI 시대에 길러야 할 역량입니다.

ch: what skills people must cultivate to survive and thrive in the AI era
how supercomputers came to defeat human quiz champions
the technical process behind AI disease diagnosis programs
the exact number of jobs a global bank predicted for the future

questions.passage: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have benefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core competencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI. Ask the right questions, rather than merely find answers. Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② How to Future-Proof Your Career in the AI Age(AI 시대에 경력을 미래에 대비시키는 법)
det.analysis:
글은 AI 시대에 살아남고 번영하기 위해 길러야 할 핵심 역량을 설명해요.

❌ ① AI Will Soon Replace Every Human Job(AI가 곧 모든 일자리를 대체할 것이다): 본문은 'you probably won't be replaced by AI'라 하므로 반대예요.

✅ ② How to Future-Proof Your Career in the AI Age(AI 시대에 경력을 미래에 대비시키는 법): 핵심 역량으로 경력을 대비시키라는 글 전체를 압축한 제목이에요 ←정답

❌ ③ The Danger of Watching Too Many Quiz Shows(퀴즈 쇼를 너무 많이 보는 것의 위험): 퀴즈 쇼는 예시일 뿐이에요.

❌ ④ Why Machines Can Truly Feel Human Emotions(기계가 인간의 감정을 진짜로 느끼는 이유): 본문은 AI가 인간적 손길이 '없다'고 했어요.
det.tip: 핵심 메시지 = AI 시대에 경력을 미래 대비시키기(Future-Proof Your Career)

ch: AI Will Soon Replace Every Human Job
How to Future-Proof Your Career in the AI Age
The Danger of Watching Too Many Quiz Shows
Why Machines Can Truly Feel Human Emotions

questions.passage: Just as much as misleading information, feeding biased information into AI causes incorrect or even harmful output. A world-famous Internet company had AI study ten years of employee records to create a new employee selection algorithm. However, the company decided not to use the algorithm when it favored men over women. The proportion of male employees was very high and thus the AI's machine learning had an underlying bias towards male data. When analyzing the information provided by AI, it is always necessary to assess the quality of information — remember: <u>garbage in, garbage out</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 garbage in, garbage out이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 입력한 정보의 질이 나쁘면 결과물의 질도 나쁘게 나온다는 것
det.analysis:
밑줄 'garbage in, garbage out'은 '쓰레기가 들어가면 쓰레기가 나온다'는 말로, 앞의 'it is always necessary to assess the quality of information(정보의 질을 평가해야 한다)'을 강조해요. 즉 입력 정보의 질이 결과물의 질을 좌우한다는 뜻이에요.

❌ ① 좋은 정보를 넣으면 좋은 결과가 나오므로 '늘 쓸모없다'는 반대예요.

✅ ② 나쁜(편향·부정확) 정보를 넣으면 나쁜 결과가 나온다는 뜻이에요 ←정답

❌ ③ 컴퓨터가 자동으로 걸러낸다는 내용은 본문에 없어요.

❌ ④ 양이 아니라 '질'에 관한 말이에요.
det.tip: garbage in, garbage out = 입력(정보의 질)이 나쁘면 출력도 나쁘다

ch: 좋은 정보를 넣어도 결과물은 늘 쓸모없게 나온다는 것
입력한 정보의 질이 나쁘면 결과물의 질도 나쁘게 나온다는 것
컴퓨터는 쓰레기 같은 데이터를 자동으로 걸러낸다는 것
정보의 양이 많을수록 결과가 더 정확해진다는 것

questions.passage: Unlike in the past, this is because you can quickly find answers on the Internet, and if you want, an AI assistant will even find an answer for you. In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer. The fact that the computer won a resounding victory shows that humans cannot keep up with computers in finding factual information. If that person were to compete with current AI, <u>he</u> would probably lose by a larger margin. We don't need to memorize all the answers, and no matter how hard we try, we cannot rival AI in memorizing vast quantities of information.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 he가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 2011년 퀴즈 쇼에서 74번 우승한 사람
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장: 'If that person were to compete with current AI, ___ would probably lose by a larger margin.'(만약 그 사람이 현재의 AI와 대결한다면 아마 더 큰 차이로 질 것이다). 앞 문장 'In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer'에서 소개한 '74번 우승자(that person)'를 he가 받아요.

✅ ① 2011년 퀴즈 쇼에서 74번 우승한 사람: that person이 가리키는 바로 그 사람이에요 ←정답

❌ ② current AI는 he가 '대결하는' 상대예요.

❌ ③ 슈퍼컴퓨터 개발자는 언급되지 않아요.

❌ ④ 독자(you)는 다른 대상이에요.
det.tip: the 74-time winner → that person → he로 이어집니다.

questions.passage: The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have __________ that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 the human touch(인간적인 손길)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① a faster processor(더 빠른 프로세서): 눈 맞춤·공감 같은 정서적 교감과 무관
❌ ② a larger memory(더 큰 메모리): 기계적 성능이라 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ an online database(온라인 데이터베이스): 정서적 교감과 무관
✅ ④ the human touch(인간적인 손길): 뒤이어 '눈을 맞추고, 고통에 공감하고, 손을 잡아 주는' 능력이 나열되므로, AI 진단 프로그램에 없는 것은 '인간적인 손길'이에요 ← 정답
det.tip: they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact ~: AI에 없는 인간적 손길

questions.passage: It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be left behind. __________. Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market. AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more. Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. More likely a person with AI skills will replace you. In conclusion, surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"그래서 우리는 평생 학습자가 되어야 한다." (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) become, is, learners, life-long, must, that, we, why 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: That is why we must become life-long learners
det.analysis:
'그래서 ~이다'는 'That is why + 주어 + 동사'로 시작해요: That + is + why.

'우리는 ~되어야 한다'는 'we must become'으로 써요: we + must + become.

'평생 학습자'는 life-long learners예요: life-long + learners.

순서대로 이으면 That / is / why / we / must / become / life-long / learners.
det.tip: That is why(그래서 ~이다) + we must become(우리는 ~되어야 한다)

questions.wa: That is why we must become life-long learners
accept: That is why we must become life-long learners

questions.passage: You must embrace change and be open to __________ (learn) and mastering new skills. It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be left behind.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: learning (전치사 to 뒤 동명사).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'be open to ___ and mastering new skills'에서 'be open to'의 to는 to부정사의 to가 아니라 전치사예요. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하고, 뒤의 mastering과 and로 병렬을 이루므로 learn을 learning으로 바꿔야 해요. 'open to learning and mastering(배우고 숙달하는 데 열려 있는)'으로 해석돼요.
det.tip: be open to + 동명사, mastering과 병렬 → learning

questions.passage: It is AI that is good at collecting and classifying information. Meanwhile, __________. The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"사람을 가장 잘 상대하는 것은 바로 인간이다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) are, at, best, dealing, humans, is, it, people, that, with 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것 (It is ~ that 강조구문 활용)

det.korean: It is humans that are best at dealing with people
det.analysis:
'~한 것은 바로 …이다'는 'It is … that ~'의 강조구문으로 써요. 강조하는 대상이 '인간(humans)'이므로 It is humans that로 시작해요: It + is + humans + that.

강조구문의 that절 동사는 강조 대상 humans(복수)에 맞춰 are로 써요: are.

'~을 가장 잘 상대하는'은 best at dealing with로 이어요: best + at + dealing + with + people.

순서대로 이으면 It / is / humans / that / are / best / at / dealing / with / people.
det.tip: It is ~ that 강조구문 + be good/best at + 동명사(dealing)

questions.wa: It is humans that are best at dealing with people
accept: It is humans that are best at dealing with people

questions.passage: Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market. AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more. Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. __________. In conclusion, surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset. Instead of fearing AI, we must embrace it as a companion in this new era and find ways to collaborate with it and complement it. We must also focus on developing interpersonal skills that machines cannot replace.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"인공지능 기술을 지닌 사람이 여러분을 대체할 가능성이 더 크다."

[ a / AI / likely / More / person / replace / skills / will / with / you ] (10단어) (영어로)

det.korean: More likely a person with AI skills will replace you
det.analysis:
'~할 가능성이 더 크다'는 'More likely + 주어 + will + 동사'로 시작해요: More + likely.

주어는 'AI 기술을 지닌 사람'이에요. '~을 지닌'은 with로 이어요: a + person + with + AI + skills.

'여러분을 대체할 것이다'는 will replace you로 써요: will + replace + you.

순서대로 이으면 More / likely / a / person / with / AI / skills / will / replace / you.
det.tip: More likely + 주어 + will ~ (~할 가능성이 더 크다), a person with AI skills(AI 기술을 지닌 사람)

questions.wa: More likely a person with AI skills will replace you
accept: More likely a person with AI skills will replace you

questions.passage: Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. More likely a person with AI skills will replace you. In conclusion, __________. Instead of fearing AI, we must embrace it as a companion in this new era and find ways to collaborate with it and complement it. We must also focus on developing interpersonal skills that machines cannot replace. By doing so, we can not only survive in this era of AI but also thrive and prosper.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"인공지능과 함께 살아남고 경쟁하는 것은 사고방식의 전환을 필요로 한다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, AI, and, competing, in, mindset, requires, shift, surviving, with 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것 (동명사 주어 활용)

det.korean: surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset
det.analysis:
주어는 '살아남고 경쟁하는 것'으로, 동명사 두 개를 and로 묶어요: surviving + and + competing.

'인공지능과 함께'는 with AI로 이어요: with + AI.

동명사 주어는 단수 취급이라 동사는 requires로 써요: requires.

'사고방식의 전환'은 a shift in mindset이에요: a + shift + in + mindset.

순서대로 이으면 surviving / and / competing / with / AI / requires / a / shift / in / mindset.
det.tip: 동명사 주어(surviving and competing) + 단수 동사 requires

questions.wa: surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset
accept: surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset
